author: DEVADAAD · InnovativeAI LLC
description: World-first constitutionally-governed adaptive learner. Closes the ADAAD mutation pipeline feedback loop by reading from IIS (INNOV-79) and MFV (INNOV-78) ledgers, computing per-invariant fitness contribution weights, and generating HUMAN-0-gated constitutional amendment recommendations. The CAL is a read-only oracle — it never self-applies recommendations.
world_first_claim: First autonomous constitutional governance system to produce HUMAN-0-gated self-improvement recommendations grounded in empirical mutation fitness history, with HMAC-chained verifiable audit trail.

invariants.description: HMAC chain must be verified before any read operation
All scoring is deterministic; no wall-clock or random calls
Amendment recommendations are HUMAN-0-gated; never auto-applied
CAL never mutates source ledgers (IIS / MFV)
Ledger writes use os.replace; never in-place JSON mutation
Every learning cycle writes an immutable audit record
CAL operates only on its declared input ledger paths
Full learning history must be deterministically replayable
CAL may not read its own ledger as an input source
